text: Technical drawing of a pump skid. Background sheet: very light gray rectangle, 780 x 480, at 400,250, background layer, name Sheet.
Tank: blue rectangle, 120 wide, 160 tall, at 110,260, called Tank.
label it "TANK 2000 L"
Add a large gray circle named Pump to the right of the tank, labelled P-101.
valve next: medium yellow diamond right of Pump, named Valve, with V1 written on it
then a small teal hexagon called Filter to the right of Valve
and finally the outlet, a medium green square named Outlet to the right of Filter.
Connect Tank, Pump, Valve, Filter and Outlet in a chain.
Motor: gray rectangle 100 by 60, below Pump, named Motor
a plain line between Motor and Pump for the shaft
Gauge: small white circle above Valve, label PSI, name Gauge
hook the gauge to the valve with a dotted line
Draw a dashed arrow from Valve back to Tank and label it "bypass".
make all the arrows navy
actually the bypass arrow should be red
Make the arrow from Tank to Pump thick, it's the main suction line.
Can I get from Tank to Outlet following the arrows?
How many arrows are there on the sheet?
Which shapes is Valve connected to?
how many connections does Pump have
Put a legend box in the top right: light gray rectangle zone, 200 by 110, named LegendBox.
write "solid = flow" at 690,65 in small navy letters
and "dashed = bypass" just under it, at 690,95, small and red
group LegendBox and both captions as Legend
Title block: "PUMP SKID P-101 rev B" in the bottom right, medium, black.
Drain: small blue triangle under Tank, called Drain
dotted line from Tank to Drain
align Pump, Valve, Filter and Outlet horizontally
Spread Valve, Filter and Outlet out evenly, horizontally.

rename Filter to Strainer
make Strainer a bit bigger
Add a tiny red circle named Alarm 8 px right of Gauge
connect Alarm to Gauge with a red dashed line
